browserContext.name: __Host-arg-session
browserContext.description: Opaque server-side ANONYMOUS/SETUP/HUMAN context; purpose is enforced per operation. Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, no Domain. Never returned in JSON or browser storage.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: Current context-bound token from same-origin bootstrap. Origin validation is required as well.

Context.description: Typed context and CSRF metadata; cookie transitions occur only in headers.

Account.description: Current human's own account and session standing.

Operation.description: Own nonsecret operation metadata; no seed, provisioning URI or codes.

AuthenticatorSecrets.description: One response only; no-store. Replays never return these values.

RecoverySecrets.description: One response only; no-store. Replays never return these values.

MailAccepted.description: Common durable admission, not account eligibility or delivery confirmation.

Failure.description: Use the checklist's exact code/status/copy mapping; never success-shaped. Correlation identifier also appears in X-Correlation-Id. Retry-After matches retryAfterSeconds when present.

X-Correlation-Id.description: Same value as the failure body correlationId.

Retry-After.description: Present only when the business outcome is a bounded temporary wait.

Email.description: Draft initial contract: ASCII mailbox without display-name/quoted-local syntax; punycode domains allowed. Trim surrounding Unicode White_Space then case-normalize the full identity. This new syntax/length disposition requires Phase 6 approval.

NewPassword.description: Unicode code points, not UTF-16 units. No trimming/normalization. Do not apply native HTML maxLength or Java UTF-16 @Size as a substitute.

CredentialPassword.description: Empty/incorrect credential values give generic authentication failure, not account-dependent validation. Received CR/LF is explicit input validation.

Factor.description: Missing/invalid factor kind/code maps to generic sign-in failure on authentication operations, never an identity-specific challenge.

message.const: If this request is eligible, we'll send an email with the next steps.

x-contract-notes: This document is the single machine shape definition for native auth Phase 4.
Exact user-visible copy and accessible locators live in native-auth/07-ui-contract.md.
Code-to-status mapping is x-failure-code-status; failures always use the Failure envelope.
A generic success-shaped response is forbidden for every failure class.
